title: Torque Converter Clutch Circuit Performance/Stuck Off (P0741-EXT)
shortDescription: TCC solenoid hydraulic circuit stuck off — converter never locks. Stored as P0741-EXT.
fullDescription: Torque Converter Clutch Circuit Performance/Stuck Off. TCC solenoid hydraulic circuit stuck off — converter never locks. The TCM/PCM monitors solenoid current, gear ratio, and slip to detect mechanical or electrical faults inside the automatic transmission. When this code sets the transmission usually enters limp mode (held in a single gear, typically 3rd or 4th) to protect the gearset from further damage. Stored as P0741-EXT.
safetyImpact: Transmission may enter limp mode — limited gears, no torque converter lockup, possible harsh shifts. Drive cautiously to a service location.

causes.cause: Failed shift or pressure control solenoid
Low or contaminated transmission fluid
Internal valve body wear or stuck valve
Damaged solenoid wiring harness or connector
Worn clutch pack or torque converter
TCM software/calibration issue

symptoms: No torque converter lockup (if TCC related)

fixSteps.title: Check Fluid Level & Condition
fixSteps.instruction: With engine warm and shifter cycled per OEM procedure, check ATF level and color. Burnt or low fluid often causes solenoid faults.

fixSteps.title: Scan TCM & Read Live Data
fixSteps.instruction: Read all TCM codes; monitor solenoid commanded vs actual, gear ratio, line pressure, and TCC slip in live data.

fixSteps.title: Test Solenoid Resistance & Wiring
fixSteps.instruction: Disconnect transmission case connector; ohm-test solenoid windings against OEM spec and check harness for shorts/opens.

fixSteps.title: Inspect Valve Body / Replace Solenoid
fixSteps.instruction: Drop pan, remove valve body, replace failed solenoid or rebuild valve body. Refill with correct OEM ATF spec.

fixSteps.title: Adaptive Reset & Road Test
fixSteps.instruction: Clear adaptives and codes with scan tool. Road test through all gears including TCC lockup at light cruise.

faq.q: Can I keep driving with this code?
faq.a: Short distances at moderate speed are usually safe, but extended driving in limp mode or with slipping clutches will accelerate internal damage.

faq.q: Will fluid change fix it?
faq.a: Sometimes — if fluid is burnt or solenoid screens are clogged, a fluid+filter service can restore solenoid function. If a solenoid is electrically failed, replacement is required.

The TCM/PCM monitors solenoid current, gear ratio, and slip to detect mechanical or electrical faults inside the automatic transmission. When this code sets the transmission usually enters limp mode (held in a single gear, typically 3rd or 4th) to protect the gearset from further damage. Stored as P090D-EXT.
safetyImpact: Transmission may enter limp mode — limited gears, no torque converter lockup, possible harsh shifts. Drive cautiously to a service location.

causes.cause: Failed shift or pressure control solenoid
Low or contaminated transmission fluid
Internal valve body wear or stuck valve
Damaged solenoid wiring harness or connector
Worn clutch pack or torque converter
TCM software/calibration issue

symptoms: No torque converter lockup (if TCC related)

fixSteps.title: Check Fluid Level & Condition
fixSteps.instruction: With engine warm and shifter cycled per OEM procedure, check ATF level and color. Burnt or low fluid often causes solenoid faults.

fixSteps.title: Scan TCM & Read Live Data
fixSteps.instruction: Read all TCM codes; monitor solenoid commanded vs actual, gear ratio, line pressure, and TCC slip in live data.

fixSteps.title: Test Solenoid Resistance & Wiring
fixSteps.instruction: Disconnect transmission case connector; ohm-test solenoid windings against OEM spec and check harness for shorts/opens.

fixSteps.title: Inspect Valve Body / Replace Solenoid
fixSteps.instruction: Drop pan, remove valve body, replace failed solenoid or rebuild valve body. Refill with correct OEM ATF spec.

fixSteps.title: Adaptive Reset & Road Test
fixSteps.instruction: Clear adaptives and codes with scan tool. Road test through all gears including TCC lockup at light cruise.

faq.q: Can I keep driving with this code?
faq.a: Short distances at moderate speed are usually safe, but extended driving in limp mode or with slipping clutches will accelerate internal damage.

faq.q: Will fluid change fix it?
faq.a: Sometimes — if fluid is burnt or solenoid screens are clogged, a fluid+filter service can restore solenoid function. If a solenoid is electrically failed, replacement is required.
